meta.title: Quarterly E&S Monitoring Report, Q3 2026
meta.subtitle: Example project: Rural Access Roads Rehabilitation, Lot 2 (illustrative figures)

items.label: workers on site, 31% from host communities

blocks.title: Key message
blocks.text: Compliance improved from 74% to 86% this quarter. Dust control on the Km 12 to Km 18 stretch and late payment of two compensation cases remain the priority issues for Q4.

This report covers environmental and social performance for July to September 2026. Civil works advanced on three of the four road sections, with **no lost-time injuries** and a sharp rise in toolbox talk attendance.
Physical progress reached 58% against a plan of 62%. Rain in August delayed earthworks on Section C.
